{{Quote|Smells like somebody died here.|Quinlan Vos's report on the house|<ref name="Hunt for Ziro" />}}
'''Mama the Hutt's house'''<ref name="Concept Art Gallery">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/hunt-for-ziro-concept-art-gallery|text="Hunt for Ziro" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 9}}</ref> was a house owned by [[Mama]] the [[Hutt]] on the [[planet]] [[Nal Hutta]]. Following Ziro's escape from Coruscant during the Clone Wars, the Hutt fled to the house. He was tracked by [[Jedi General]]s [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Quinlan Vos]], using Vos's [[force power]] of [[psychometry]]. When the two [[Jedi]] entered her house, Vos reported that it smelled like someone died in her house.<ref name="Hunt for Ziro" />
